title: Hindi for Hindi Speakers
description: For students who comprehend informal spoken Hindi but wish to improve their communicative and sociocultural competence and their analytic understanding. Language functions for oral communication, reading, writing, and entertainment/culture; dialect and language style differences; structure and history of Hindi. This is a distance education course equivalent to LIHL 119P. LIHL 119F(R), LIHL 119W(R), and LIHL 119P(R) may be taken in any order. Students may not receive credit for both LIHL 119PR and LIHL 119P. Prerequisites: upper-division standing or consent of instructor; appropriate proficiency for level.
